organicUse.conditions: (f) Excipients—only for use in the manufacture of drugs and biologics used to treat organic livestock when the excipient is: (1) Identified by the FDA as Generally Recognized As Safe; (2) Approved by the FDA as a food additive; (3) Included in the FDA review and approval of a New Animal Drug Application or New Drug Application; or (4) Approved by APHIS for use in veterinary biologics.

notes: Clostridial 7-way vaccine for healthy cattle and sheep. The label states one slaughter restriction and no milk or egg restriction, so none is recorded and milk stays unknown.
